Monitor guide indexing and search queries
Measure field Core Web Vitals when sufficient traffic is available

reaudit.scope: Live homepage, guide hub, all 12 guides, screenshots, local assets, internal and external links including fragments
reaudit.external_limit: Four GitHub source-file pages returned temporary HTTP 429 responses. Their exact paths were verified in the current Git checkout; no broken destination was established.
fixes: Use current Audio & voice and Privacy settings labels, and point network echo testing to Connection / Diagnostics
Explain QR trust binding for encrypted PWA messages and channel media, including certificate rotation
Provision service database roles before starting an isolated backup restoration
Link server operators directly to HTTPS app hosting instructions
Refresh real desktop and PWA captures, include sign-in, You and Connection diagnostics, and require complete visible PWA controls
Keep mobile guide navigation in reading order and preserve each image caption when enlarged
Validate cross-page fragments in the deterministic browser crawl
Remove duplicate step numbers in the guide tables of contents
Limit reference prose to a readable measure
Replace landing-page eyebrow, tilted image and floating callouts with one product-led composition
hallmark.interpretation: Marketing word budgets and one-line link rules do not fit long technical guides. Raw mechanical gate counts were triaged rather than presented as broken-page counts or a universal pass.

impeccable.implementation: Pointer-driven, critically damped WebGL voice-wave geometry around an actual client screenshot; at most 500000 drawing-buffer pixels; no continuous idle rendering
impeccable.review: Independent visual review confirmed legible hero actions, honest screenshot labels, correct fallbacks and no page errors. Back/forward-cache lifecycle behavior was corrected.

code_review.resolution: The new binary screenshot files are explicitly committed and browser-verified. The suggested hidden-canvas issue is already prevented by the shared [hidden] display:none!important rule and covered by reduced-motion, touch and unavailable-WebGL checks.

reaudit.measurement_limits: Browser checks are functional and visual lab evidence; they do not establish field Core Web Vitals, indexing, traffic or ranking gains. No physical mid-range phone or GPU frame-rate benchmark was available.
